# CareShield Life (fixture)

This is a deliberate deterministic test fixture in the owner-curated
markdown style. The content is invented for testing and is not real
scheme guidance.

## What it covers

CareShield Life provides long-term care insurance payouts for as long
as a severely disabled member remains severely disabled.

Monthly payouts start when a claim is approved and continue while the
disability assessment holds.

## How to claim

- Ask a MOH-accredited assessor to complete the disability assessment.
- Submit the claim online with the assessment report.
- Payouts begin after approval.

Contact the official agency if the assessment result seems wrong.
